From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial: success criteria & RACI - ClearlakeHealth

Hi Mark —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through Clearlake's evaluation goals. As promised, here's a concise recap of next steps and the proposed success criteria for the 4-week POC/trial. Please review and confirm any changes so we can lock timelines and owners.

Summary / Objectives:
- Validate Redwood inference performance on Clearlake patient-summary workloads (avg seq length ~800)
- Confirm integration with your app stack (API + auth) and that latency < 350ms p50 for targeted flows
- Measure token cost per 1k QPS-equivalent baseline and identify optimization levers
- Verify security/compliance controls for audit logs and key management

Proposed success criteria (draft):
1) Functional: end-to-end integration demo with sample dataset, model responses within expected bounds for clinical summarization (precision/recall targets TBD)
2) Performance: p50 latency < 350ms and p95 < 700ms on dedicated pool with expected concurrency
3) Cost: steady-state per-token cost within estimated budget (we'll provide a model-specific estimate once we pick variant)
4) Security: audit logs present and accessible, KMS integration validated in staging

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW, confirm infra owners and access (procurement/infra/security contacts)
- Week 1: infra & network prep + model onboarding
- Week 2: integration + functional checks
- Week 3: load/performance runs and optimization tuning
- Week 4: final acceptance demo and decision meeting

RACI / Ownership (initial):
- Redwood: model onboarding, runtime configuration, test harness, monitoring dashboards (Marissa)
- Clearlake - App Owner: TBD (Mark/engineering)
- Clearlake - Infra: Dev Patel (internal Redwood contact to coordinate infra?)
- Clearlake - Security: Sofia Ramos (security/compliance)
- Procurement: Sofia Ramos (procurement/PO)

Attachments: clearlake-poc-success-criteria.xlsx, raci-stakeholder-mapping.pdf (draft)

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or suggest edits (especially the functional accuracy targets).
2) Confirm infra and procurement owners and target dates for network access and PO.
3) If Clearlake wants to tweak the 4-week timeline, flag now.

I'll follow up with an invite for a short alignment call once we have the owners confirmed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0192
